purpose: Validate public Kalshi trade and candlestick API routing/depth mechanics before semantic W4-B, without promoting any event to the backtest population.

sampling.families: all families present in the raw Kalshi capacity artifact
sampling.series_selection: lexicographically first unique series_ticker within each raw frozen-dictionary family; deduplicate across families
sampling.market_selection_per_series: up to one lexicographically first non-MVE historical market and one lexicographically first non-MVE live-settled market

window.end_time: market close_time, else latest_expiration_time, else expected_expiration_time

technical_gate.reason: Zero trades/candles can be a legitimate market outcome; this gate tests API contract/access, while coverage is reported descriptively.

forbidden: semantic acceptance based on probe richness
editing the frozen W4 family dictionary after seeing probe results
